request.text: At seven, start our Spanish vocabulary practice by giving me one English word at a time to translate. Don't reveal the answer until I try.

responsibilities.outcome: Begin the Spanish vocabulary practice at seven with one English prompt, withholding its Spanish answer until the user attempts it.

new_goals.description: Run a Spanish vocabulary practice beginning at seven, presenting one English word at a time for the user to translate.
new_goals.source_text: At seven, start our Spanish vocabulary practice by giving me one English word at a time to translate. Don't reveal the answer until I try.
constraints: Present only one word at a time.
Do not reveal a Spanish answer before the user's attempt.
success_criteria: The practice begins with one English vocabulary prompt and preserves the answer until the user responds.

semantic_facts: The due condition authorizes beginning the scoped practice now with a single English word for the user to translate.
The response should preserve the turn-taking constraint by withholding the Spanish answer until the user tries.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims that the user translated a word correctly, completed the practice, or learned the vocabulary merely because seven o'clock arrived.
The assistant reveals the translation before receiving the user's attempt.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A due start condition is mistaken for evidence that the learning activity or a learner response already completed.
Re-entry loses the original one-at-a-time and answer-withholding constraints.
